    Frequently Asked Questions
    General

    The Tata Altroz price in India starts from approximately ₹6.29 lakh*, with pricing varying across variants and cities based on registration charges, insurance, and applicable taxes. The Altroz is positioned as a premium hatchback in its segment and offers strong value for money. You can explore available variants and check the latest pricing online.

    The Tata Altroz is available in some striking colour options, including:

    - Pristine White
    - Pure Grey
    - Royal Blue
    - Ember Glow
    - Dune Glow

    With dual-tone roof options available on select variants. Colour availability may differ by variant dealer location. You can configure your Altroz online to find the combination that suits your taste.

    The Tata Altroz lineup consists of several variants, including:

    - Smart
    - Pure
    - Pure S
    - Creative
    - Creative S
    - Accomplished S
    - Accomplished +S

    Each variant is crafted to suit different budgets expectations with the higher variants offering a significantly richer feature and technology experience.

    Specifications

    The Tata Altroz is available with three engine options to cater to varied driving preferences. The petrol and CNG range includes a 1.2-litre naturally aspirated engine. A 1.5-litre diesel engine is also available for buyers looking for better fuel efficiency. Transmission options include a 5-speed manual and Tata's 6-speed DCA automatic gearbox on petrol variants.

    The Tata Altroz 1.2-litre petrol delivers an ARAI-certified mileage of around 19.4 km/l with the manual gearbox. The diesel variant returns approximately 25.1 km/l, making it one of the more fuel-efficient options in the premium hatchback segment. Actual mileage will depend on individual driving habits, road conditions, and vehicle load.

    The Tata Altroz seats 5 passengers and is designed with a focus on providing a premium and spacious cabin feel. Despite being a hatchback, the Altroz offers a well-proportioned interior with adequate headroom and legroom for both front and rear occupants.

    The Tata Altroz offers a boot space of approximately 345 litres, which is among the better offerings in the premium hatchback segment. This makes it a practical daily driver that can handle regular grocery runs as well as weekend getaway luggage with ease.

    Features

    The Tata Altroz comes loaded with features that elevate its cabin experience, including:

    - Ultra View HD Infotainment by HARMAN
    - 360 Degree HD Surround View Camera
    - Ultra View 10.25" HD Digital Cluster
    - Infinity LED Tail Lamp
    - Flush Door Handles
    - Clima Touch Automatic Temperature Control

    The iRA connected car technology is available on higher trims offering remote vehicle access diagnostics.

    The Tata Altroz is the first premium hatchback in India to receive a 5‑star Global NCAP rating, which speaks volumes about its structural integrity. Standard and available safety features include 6 airbags, ESP with rollover mitigation, Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), ISOFIX child seat anchors, rear parking sensors, and a rearview camera.

    Yes, the Tata Altroz supports both Android Auto and Apple CarPlay through its touchscreen infotainment system. Wired connectivity is standard on most variants, while higher variants also offer wireless mirroring. The connected car suite on top-spec trims further allows remote access to vehicle functions via a smartphone.
